summary.text: Jodi Emerson is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 91 since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.

paragraphs.text: Jodi Emerson first took office on January 7, 2019, succeeding Democrat Dana Wachs in District 91.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the Colleges and Universities, Criminal Justice and Public Safety, and Housing and Real Estate committees.
